Name: Salad's Pink And Purple Dinosaurs Recolor
Author: saladcreates
Description:
Turns all of the dinosaurs in your coop to pink and purple.

To use, download the file and drag it into your mods folder.

Check out my profile for more Coop/Barn animals that match.

Requires Smapi and Content Patcher.

Looks cutesy when used with [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]Cute Valley[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531]PinkStation's Cotton Candy Recolor[/url]﻿.

Manifest.Name: Salad's Pink/Purple Dinosaurs
Manifest.Description: Changes dinosaurs to purple and pink.
